text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing with Hishi 
Akebono, we talked about the pottery class 
we took together before.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I managed to get a second reservation! 
Last time I only got as far as the design, 
but this time for sure, I'm making my 
ideal clay pot!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Ehehe. Once it's finished, I wonder 
what kind of chanko nabe I should make~♪

"Her second pottery class. Hishi Akebono 
began spinning the pottery wheel under 
instruction, but she had already made 
numerous failed attempts."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew... Time for a quick break!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about spinning it around, is 
it? It looks simple enough, but the 
strength and the movements are super 
delicate!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, it's taking shape 
way better than before! If I practice 
more, I might get closer to my ideal 
design.
choice_data_list: Akebono Really Never Gives Up, Huh

Akebono Really Never Gets Discouraged, 
Does She

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
? Why? Because the more I practice, the 
better I get! I don't have any time to 
feel discouraged~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright, break's over! I'm gonna go do my 
super best again~!

That day, too, we didn't get as far as 
baking, carrying it over to next time. And 
then, the next day—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Lend me your strength!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, what's up all of a sudden? If 
there's anything I can do, just say the 
word!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Really!? Thank you!! It's an emergency!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"By tomorrow... Before tomorrow's field 
trip, I have to prepare the lunches!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Field trip? Was there a field trip 
scheduled for tomorrow?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yup, there is! Actually, a kid I know—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see, your parents are busy, so they 
couldn't prepare a lunchbox for you...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
As an ally of justice, I can't just ignore 
this!! ...Even though I can't cook, let 
alone make a bento!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Leave it to me!! I'll teach you 
everything you need to know!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ooooh, thanks, Bono!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, the eggs burned again!! And the 
salmon crumbled into pieces, too...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Just scrape off the burnt parts and it'll 
be fine! Let's just mix the salmon into 
the rice!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Guh!? My hand slipped, and I spilled 
sugar on the meat...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Using sugar during the prep work makes the 
meat super tender and delicious☆

Hishi Akebono supports Biko Pegasus, 
teaching her with great care.

"It's not completely inedible, but after 
so many consecutive failures, Biko Pegasus 
seems a little downhearted."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, they're tough...! I'm sorry, it's 
just because I'm not good enough...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I think it's no problem at all☆ It's 
different from the planned menu, but it 
turned out totally delicious!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if I'm failing this much, can I 
even make it properly tomorrow for the 
real deal?! With my skill right now, 
making a bento is just...!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No prob, no prob! We still have time, and 
almost nobody gets it right on the first 
try anyway!

Akebono's Been Practicing a Lot Too,

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course! After failing over and over 
again, I was finally able to do it~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still, because I kept making them without 
giving up, I am who I am today!! So let's 
do our best, Biko-chan! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
! R-Right...! It's the same for an ally of 
justice... They never give up! Uoooooh, 
I'm gonna keep practicing!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Dosukoi, let's do this!!

—The next morning, it seems the bento was 
successfully finished. It was a day that 
showed me the foundation of Hishi 
Akebono's unyielding strength of heart.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I practiced a looooot~! Way too many times 
to count, even. When I was a kid, I messed 
up more often than not.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I did my best because I wanted to 
eat something tasty! After all, good food 
was waiting at the end of the struggle! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
! Right... Some enemies aren't so easily 
defeated. A hero is someone who faces them 
again and again, overcoming any hardship!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, let's do our best together!! I'll 
join you as many times as it takes♪

With Hishi Akebono's support, she managed 
to safely complete the boxed lunch. It was 
a day that proved the power of never 
giving up.
